archetypes.name: White-Blue Tempo
archetypes.plan: Build around Dauntless River Marshal: Deploy evasive attackers, tap or bounce opposing blockers, and end the game before the opponent recovers tempo.

archetypes.name: Blue-Black Lifegain
archetypes.plan: Build around Jorubai Murk Lurker: Use lifelink and incidental life gain to stabilize races while efficient interaction creates favorable attacks.

archetypes.name: Black-Red Attrition
archetypes.plan: Build around Nightfire Giant: Trade removal and creatures aggressively, then let repeatable late-game damage win the resource exchange.

archetypes.name: Red-Green Monsters
archetypes.plan: Build around Kird Chieftain: Curve mana acceleration into oversized threats, then grant trample or remove blockers to convert size into lethal damage.

archetypes.name: Green-White Convoke
archetypes.plan: Build around Sunblade Elf: Create a wide board early, tap spare creatures to convoke larger plays, and finish with a team-wide boost.
